user.title: KE2 LDA
user.description: Enter the LDA's **IP address** (not its hostname: the LDA redirects other names to KE2's cloud). Reading needs no login; the credentials are used for changing settings. Factory default is ke2admin / ke2admin.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach a KE2 LDA with controllers at that address.
error.invalid_auth: The LDA rejected the username or password.

abort.unique_id_mismatch: That address belongs to a different LDA.

data.advanced_setpoints: Expose advanced settings (Modbus address, temperature units)

set_value.name: Set raw value
set_value.description: Write any writable controller field, validated against the controller's limits. Use for values entities can't express, e.g. 24:00 to disable a custom defrost start time.

entity_id.name: Entity
entity_id.description: Any entity of the target controller.
